verdict.rationale: Sentry ships AI agent tracing and LLM observability, so an evals-and-datasets capability is a fair question for it. However, the evidence covers only tracing, conversation replay, LLM-call comparison and dashboards. Nothing shows dataset creation, programmatic eval runs, or reading back eval results, and an official CLI's existence alone does not establish eval functionality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create a dataset, trigger an eval run programmatically, and read back the results
